legacy.body: Welcome! Data created before accounts existed now belongs to you: {{items}}. Other users won't see it.

profile.title: Profile
profile.adminNote: You are an administrator of this installation.
profile.passwordNeeded: Required to change your login name or email.

language.title: Language
language.help: Saved to your account, so it follows you to other devices.

password.title: Password
password.help: Changing your password signs you out everywhere else.
password.changed: Password changed. Other sessions were signed out.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.help: Devices where you are signed in. Revoke any you don't recognize.

export.title: Export my data
export.help: Download your conversations, prompts and settings as JSON.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.help: Permanently deletes your account and everything in it: conversations, prompts, knowledge, uploads and personal connections.
delete.confirmBody: This cannot be undone. Enter your password to confirm.
